variables.title: Four Arrows and PHS
variables.subtitle: Human Design Advanced Analysis
variables.intro: The Four Arrows are an advanced layer of Human Design: the left arrows (Design side) describe the Primary Health System (PHS), and the right arrows (Personality side) describe Rave Psychology. Each arrow is calculated from the Color, Tone and Base substructure of its source planetary activation.
variables.precisionNote: This layer is very sensitive to the birth time: a difference of a few minutes can change the Tone and the direction of the arrow. The result is calculated on the assumption that the recorded birth time is exact; if the time is an estimate, do not treat the result as certain.
variables.baseNote: Base is a finer subdivision than a normal birth time can resolve; it is shown for information only and its meaning is not interpreted.
variables.healthNote: The PHS and Environment descriptions are interpretations from the Human Design teaching; they are not medical diagnosis, treatment, diet or nutrition advice.
variables.uncertainNote: Possible result: the source of this arrow is very close to a Color or Tone boundary. The values shown were calculated with the recorded time; if the actual moment of birth differs by a few seconds or minutes, the neighbouring Color / Tone and arrow direction may apply. For this reason the Color, Tone and direction meanings are not shown for this arrow; do not use it as a definitive interpretation.
variables.uncertainAdvice: To confirm the possible arrows, verify the birth time with an official record or document; if the time is documented and the result is still possible, no definitive interpretation can be made for this arrow.
variables.historicalOffsetNote: This birth falls in the local mean time period before standard time was adopted. The calculation service uses that period's time offset with the seconds dropped, so the result may shift by up to one minute: Base values could not be confirmed and arrows close to a boundary were not treated as certain.
variables.allUncertainNote: Not all four arrows are certain: the arrows that could not be confirmed are marked separately as “Possible” below.
variables.sourceNote: The descriptions are texts from the calculation service (the original English is shown when no translation is available). The result was checked for consistency against Yaşam Sistemi's independent calculation.

certain.text: The value is far enough from the Color / Tone boundary; even if the recorded birth time shifts by a few minutes, the Color, Tone and arrow direction do not change. Their meanings are shown.

possible.text: The value was calculated with the recorded time but is very close to a boundary; depending on the actual moment of birth, the neighbouring value may also apply. The values are marked with “?” and a dashed line, and their meanings are not given as an interpretation.

variables.cardAriaUncertain: {title}: could not be confirmed — possible {dirLower} direction, possible Color {color}, possible Tone {tone}
variables.cognitionHidden: not shown because the Tone could not be confirmed (the possible Tone may correspond to a different Cognition).
variables.mismatch: The server response did not match this analysis; the result was not shown. Please try again.
variables.allCertain: All four arrows are certain (each arrow is far enough from the Color / Tone boundary).
